tasks.short: Develop and maintain archived queries and procedures

steps.what: Define application query requirements, archived procedure versions and representative expected results
Develop draft procedural codes or queries in an isolated development branch

loop.purpose: Draft a bounded query or procedure change from explicit requirements
loop.input: Versioned source, schema, expected cases and permitted changes
loop.output: Branch diff and proposed tests with assumptions identified
loop.check: Architect inspects semantics, transaction behavior, permissions, nulls and error paths; trusted expected results are checked independently of generated tests.
loop.stop: One draft and correction pass; failing or unclear changes are implemented manually, with no production credentials available.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates cover boilerplate, but a changed query's logic varies with the application requirement.

steps.what: Test query behavior and accept the exact archived procedure version after review

tasks.design: Use existing source control, native query tooling and tests in {DATA_PLATFORM}; bounded coding assistance drafts a branch change. The architect establishes expected behavior, tests it independently and accepts the exact archived version; production deployment remains outside this design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure changes require repetitive implementation after behavior is specified.
tasks.enabler_now: Coding assistance can draft source changes under human oversight.
tasks.still_hard: A syntactically valid query can have incorrect semantics or dangerous transaction behavior.
tasks.human_edge: Define the intended behavior and judge the adequacy of independent tests.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time on first-pass code while retaining behavioral design and acceptance.

reach.task: Review a query change against warehouse semantics
reach.learn: How expected result cases expose grain and join errors

evidence.claim: GitHub Copilot offers completion, review and coding assistance with expected oversight; this does not establish safe autonomous database changes.
Local drafting shares and net savings are unmeasured and depend on independent testing.

assumptions: Boundary is development and archived-source maintenance, excluding production execution, migration and live recovery. Existing deployment authority is unchanged.

Application owners supply requirements and developers supply source/schema versions before s1. In s1 the architect captures target version, permitted objects/actions, input types, expected rows/results, edge cases and transaction constraints; its 30 hours include source inspection and expected-case construction. No free complete specification or test-passed flag is assumed. Unclear requirements use manual implementation after clarification.

Native query builders, templates and linting come first. Generated tests cannot establish their own correctness; s3 includes isolated execution and independent expected-result checks. No new specification duty is transferred to application owners.
unknowns: Approved source access and representative test environment
research_questions: Does code drafting reduce total change effort after independent behavioral and transaction testing?

already_counted.description: Independent tests and exact source acceptance

incremental.description: Failed-draft investigation and regression fixture upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact source commit, schema assumptions and independent test evidence archived; changed source requires renewed architect review. This acceptance does not authorize production deployment.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=84, gross=16, focal upkeep=6, net=10. Range 0-4 allows existing templates, difficult query semantics and generated changes requiring extensive rework.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the technical support request, database context and permitted evidence access
Draft technical support guidance from approved version-matched documentation

loop.purpose: Prepare a source-linked explanation for the clarified request
loop.input: Verified context and approved relevant documentation passages
loop.output: Draft guidance with source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Architect checks version compatibility, prerequisites, access limits and whether each instruction follows from the source; no unsupported operational command is sent.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unsupported or high-risk cases receive manual diagnosis and guidance.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native search locates known articles, but adapting explanation to a clarified free-text question can require language interpretation.

steps.what: Provide checked guidance, investigate unresolved issues and confirm the requester's understanding

tasks.design: Use native knowledge search in {HELPDESK} first, then bounded drafting from approved {DOCS} passages for covered requests. The architect retains clarification, troubleshooting and the exact guidance release; the system takes no database action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Known guidance is repeatedly adapted to similar questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Service-desk knowledge drafting exists, though database-specific applicability remains local work.
tasks.still_hard: An apparent routine question may hide an unsafe operational context.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when advice requires diagnosis or escalation instead of a standard answer.
tasks.altitude: Reuse verified knowledge while preserving direct technical support.

reach.learn: How to distinguish user guidance from operational intervention

evidence.claim: TOPdesk drafts knowledge items for review; the local source-bounded database guidance design and savings remain E1.
Adapting reviewed documentation to a clarified request may reduce draft effort without replacing diagnosis.

assumptions: Boundary is architect support, excluding requester execution, production changes and independent incident response. No requester's extra data-entry task is added.

Requesters supply their account during s1 and existing documentation owners supply approved articles before s1. The architect captures issue wording, system/version, symptoms, source evidence, intended recipient and access limits in s1; its 35 hours include manual evidence inspection and clarification. No free routine-request or authorized-action flag is assumed. Missing documentation uses manual support.

Native article search and fixed responses come first. Requesters provide follow-up during s3 before the architect responds; no preexisting resolution or understanding flag is assumed. Shared training questions are assigned once across support and training.
unknowns: Approved article coverage and actual draft share
research_questions: Does source-bounded guidance save effort after context capture, checking and unresolved issue handling?

already_counted.description: Exact guidance acceptance, explanation and diagnosis

incremental.description: Knowledge accuracy sampling and stale-answer handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact recipient, system/version, source passages and instructions communicated; changed guidance requires renewed architect acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=90, gross=10, focal upkeep=5, net=5. Range 0-2 allows poor knowledge coverage, extensive diagnosis and already-reused standard answers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check database workload measurements, manual versions and candidate parameter calculation assumptions
Calculate candidate values for database parameters using specified formulas and bounds
Evaluate candidate database parameters and establish qualified values with explicit limitations

tasks.design: Use native parameter calculators or protected {SPREADSHEET} formulas from verified measurements in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The architect evaluates the scenarios against versioned manuals in {DOCS}; a computed candidate is not claimed to be a proven optimum or automatically applied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated parameter arithmetic follows inspection of manuals and workloads.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit formulas and units permit deterministic calculation without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Representative workloads, parameter interactions and objectives determine whether a value is suitable.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a calculator's assumptions do not represent operating conditions.
tasks.altitude: Maintain calculation assumptions and assess candidate suitability rather than repeat arithmetic.

reach.learn: How sampling conditions limit parameter conclusions

evidence.claim: Specified parameter formulas can be calculated deterministically; this does not establish an operational optimum or local measured savings.

assumptions: Boundary is calculation and recommendation, excluding production application and separate load-testing projects. A recommendation requiring tests remains provisional; no testing result is invented.

Existing monitoring supplies measurements and the database publisher supplies manuals before s1. In s1 the architect captures database/version, workload window and units, resource limits, candidate formulas, objectives, allowable bounds and measurement limitations. Its 35 hours include export, manual capture and representativeness checks; no free representative-workload or optimum flag exists. Missing units or unsupported formulas use manual investigation.
Native calculators and existing monitoring exports precede custom code. No new monitoring or measurement production duty is transferred to operations.
unknowns: Reliable manual formulas and representative measurements
Actual calculation share and operational validation needs
research_questions: Does configured arithmetic save effort after workload and formula validation are included?

incremental.description: Versioned formula maintenance and unusual-case handling

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=70, gross=30, focal upkeep=8, net=22. Range 0-8 allows native automatic calculators, unrepresentative measurements and coupled parameters requiring substantial review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train database users and answer questions

steps.what: Train users through explanation and demonstration, then answer questions and check understanding

tasks.design: Keep live training, demonstration and understanding checks with the architect. Existing {DOCS} and safe demonstrations in {DATA_PLATFORM} support learning without equating an answer draft to user competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective training depends on what users understand and can do.
tasks.enabler_now: The task establishes no separate training-material authoring share to automate.
tasks.still_hard: A correct explanation may not resolve the learner's misconception.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the attempt, adapt the explanation and identify unsafe misunderstandings.
tasks.altitude: User learning time remains direct human work.

reach.learn: How to distinguish procedural recall from actual understanding

evidence.claim: Interactive user training requires observation and adaptation; no measured training-time reduction follows from coding or knowledge-draft tools alone.

assumptions: Boundary is training delivery and questions, excluding course authoring and individual incident support. Overlapping support questions are assigned once.

The architect provides approved examples before instruction; users supply questions and attempts during s1 before understanding is assessed. Clarification remains counted; no free trained-user or successful-completion flag is assumed.
Use existing safe demonstrations and native learning resources first. No new tool, transferred work or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: User prerequisites and practical training needs
research_questions: Which misconceptions only become visible when users try the operation?

already_counted.description: Instruction, questions, adaptation and understanding checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Live instruction and learning checks retain their time; no material-authoring baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use bounded source and guidance drafts plus transparent parameter arithmetic while retaining tests, diagnosis and user learning.
reach: Review query semantics with data warehousing specialists
role.ambitious_version: An architect with less first-pass drafting and arithmetic, and unchanged control of database behavior and technical guidance.
